title: University of Pisa relies on Vertiv for data infrastructure capacity expansion to support high-performance computing and AI
summary: Deployed power and liquid cooling solutions respond to the challenges of 'The Hybrid Green Data Centre Expansion' project to improve energy efficiency, reduce operating costs and optimise available space
body_text: London, UK [March 27, 2024] - Vertiv , (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions, has been selected by the University of Pisa to extend its existing data centre infrastructure and provide the new power and liquid cooling equipment needed to meet the new demands of high-performance computing systems and maintain high operational flexibility. The University of Pisa, founded in 1343, is one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in Italy and Europe. Its organisation is made up of 20 departments, which include humanities, sciences and computer sciences, with about 50,000 students enrolled in different degree courses. The University already had three data centres in the city to support teaching and research activities and needed to further enhance the infrastructure to provide greater efficiency and agility. In 2016, the University of Pisa embarked on a project for the development of a new data centre called " The Green Data Centre ". Vertiv was chosen to provide the critical power and cooling infrastructure, and the successful implementation of the project led to a strong technical and strategic relationship with the University. More recently, the University turned to Vertiv to expand this data centre and support the infrastructure demands of high-performance computing applications. “The main objective of our project known as ‘ The Hybrid Green Data Centre Expansion’ was to use the available wing of the building, while keeping the original design and user interface intact,” said Maurizio Davini, CTO at the University of Pisa. “We also needed to integrate new technology elements that help to meet the growing demands of high-performance computing, while providing excellent operational flexibility. The requirements have been fully met by Vertiv, which has allowed us to keep energy costs under control for efficient management of our new data centre." “The increasing adoption of high density and AI applications is demanding innovative infrastructure strategies,” said Giordano (Gio) Albertazzi, CEO at Vertiv. “Vertiv's solutions, including liquid cooling for direct-to-chip applications and high density power systems, will provide the University of Pisa with the capacity they need to support a new generation of computing and future generations of student research." Vertiv provided a mix of power, cooling, rack, networking and service solutions, including four Vertiv™ DCC containment solutions for corridor closures. In terms of cooling, the hybrid solution includes twenty Vertiv™ Liebert® CRV row-based cooling units and two Vertiv™ Liebert® PDX-PI direct expansion floor-mount cooling systems with variable speed compressors, as well as three Vertiv™ Liebert® XDU liquid cooling units, which control the temperature and flow of the refrigerant to the servers in a direct-to-chip application. Vertiv also supplied several power solutions, including two Vertiv™ Liebert® APM 500 kVA UPS (uninterruptible power supply) systems and VRLA batteries, eight Vertiv™ Liebert® RXA switchgear units, a 400kW Vertiv™ Power Module prefab solution, 76 Vertiv™ Geist™ Switched PDUs (power distribution unit) and 38 Vertiv™ VR racks. In particular, the external Vertiv Power Module enabled the expansion of the data centre despite space constraints within the building. Vertiv provided a turnkey solution, managing the suppliers and subcontractors to complete the interior space with fire detection and extinguishing systems while an external 630kW backup generator was integrated with the Vertiv Power Module. Vertiv also provided consulting, design, installation and commissioning services, including the integration of the Vertiv™ Environet™ Alert monitoring software, which allows the customer to remotely monitor the entire infrastructure. "Based on the needs highlighted, we suggested to the University of Pisa to adopt Liebert® XDU liquid cooling systems, and then created tailor-made hybrid corridors, which integrate both air cooled and new liquid cooled equipment,” said Andrea Faeti, sales director for enterprise accounts in Italy at Vertiv. “The hydraulic infrastructure has been expanded, allowing previously installed cooling units to supply chilled water to new data centre equipment. In addition, space constraints prompted us to design an external Vertiv Power Module customised to the site's specific requirements. The solution was completed with our monitoring service that provides real-time visibility and control to the entire data centre infrastructure." Among the main benefits provided by the newly deployed Vertiv solutions is the implementation of liquid cooling in existing air-cooled data centres. Combining air and liquid cooling is one of the latest trends in thermal management, to enable reduced energy usage for higher capacities of cooling. Finally, the new infrastructure provides a series of benefits such as high resiliency, efficient cooling for high-density equipment, and enhanced monitoring and management to maintain system availability. For more information about Vertiv’s work with the University of Pisa, read the case study at this link . To learn more about Vertiv solutions for AI and high-density applications, visit Vertiv.com . About Vertiv Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) combines hardware, software and services to enable the continuity and operational optimisation of critical infrastructure, supporting its customers' business strategies. Vertiv solves the toughest challenges for data centres, telecommunications networks, and digital facilities for commercial and industrial applications with a comprehensive portfolio of technologies and services for power and continuity, cooling, and IT infrastructure solutions, from the cloud to the edge. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio (USA) and with a global presence, Vertiv operates in more than 130 countries. For more information, Vertiv news and content updates, please visit Vertiv.com . body_text: View All News Flowserve Divests Legacy Asbestos Liabilities October 28, 2025 Divestiture includes all asbestos liabilities, related insurance assets, and associated deferred tax assets Simplifies capital structure, reduces volatility, and strengthens cash flow generation Improves flexibility for capital allocation toward strategic growth opportunities DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Flowserve Corporation (NYSE:FLS) (“Flowserve” or the “Company”), a leading provider of flow control products and services for the global infrastructure markets, has reached an agreement to divest BW/IP - New Mexico, Inc. (“BW/IP”), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company that holds asbestos liabilities and related insurance assets, to an affiliate of Acorn Investment Partners (“Acorn”), a portfolio company of funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management L.P. Under the terms of the agreement, Acorn will assume full responsibility for BW/IP and its administration and resolution of all current and future asbestos-related claims associated with the acquired liabilities. As a result of the transaction, Flowserve will permanently divest these liabilities, enabling the Company to simplify its capital structure and focus its future capital allocation towards value enhancing opportunities. At closing, Flowserve will have no further financial exposure to the transferred liabilities, which will be fully managed and administered by Acorn, and for which Flowserve will be fully indemnified. Transaction Overview Acorn will acquire 100% of the equity in BW/IP. At closing of the transaction, BW/IP will be capitalized with the related insurance assets and a total of approximately $219 million in cash, of which Flowserve will contribute $199 million in cash and Acorn will contribute $20 million in cash. As a result of the transaction, Flowserve will remove all asbestos liabilities, related insurance assets, and associated deferred tax assets from the Company’s consolidated balance sheet. The estimated impact of the divestiture will be a one-time loss of approximately $135 million in the fourth quarter of 2025, including certain transaction related costs, and subject to customary closing adjustments as of the final close date. The one-time loss will be excluded from adjusted earnings per share. The transaction, which is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2025, will improve free cash flow by approximately $15 million to $20 million annually. Morgan Securities LLC is serving as financial advisor, and Baker McKenzie is serving as legal advisor to Flowserve. Debevoise & Plimpton LLP is serving as legal advisor to Acorn. Operating in more than 50 countries, the Company produces engineered and industrial pumps, seals and valves as well as a range of related flow management services. Founded in 2025, Acorn Investment Partners, a portfolio company of funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, L.P., takes a modern and proprietary approach to asset management. THIS IS AN ANNOUNCEMENT FALLING UNDER RULE 2.4 OF THE CITY CODE ON TAKEOVERS AND MERGERS (THE "CODE") AND DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A FIRM INTENTION TO MAKE AN OFFER UNDER RULE 2.7 OF THE CODE. THERE CAN BE NO CERTAINTY THAT ANY FIRM OFFER WILL BE MADE. SAN FRANCISCO , July 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Prologis, Inc. ("Prologis") announces its Best and Final* proposal to the Board of SEGRO plc ("SEGRO") (the "Best and Final Proposal") pursuant to which Prologis would make an offer to acquire the entire issued and to be issued share capital of SEGRO (the "Combination"). The Best and Final Proposal is final and will not be increased*. Prologis believes the Best and Final Proposal provides a compelling opportunity for both sets of shareholders and urges SEGRO shareholders to encourage their Board to recommend the Combination. The Best and Final Proposal consists of: 0.0920 new Prologis shares for each SEGRO share, a 9.5 per cent increase over Prologis' initial proposal; and a Partial Cash Alternative of up to £3.5bn, representing 25 per cent of the total consideration, at a fixed price of 1,031.7 pence per SEGRO share, subject to pro-rata scale-back. Based on Prologis' closing share price of $149.94 and the GBP:USD exchange rate of 1.3371 on 21 July 2026, being the last practicable date prior to this announcement, and assuming a shareholder elects for 25 per cent cash, the Best and Final Proposal values each SEGRO share at 1,031.7 pence, representing: a premium of 14.0 per cent to SEGRO's pro forma adjusted NAV of 905 pence per share as of 30 June 2026; a premium of 39.0 per cent to the closing price of 742 pence per share on 23 June 2026 (being the day prior to the commencement of the offer period); a premium of 41.3 per cent to the 1-month volume weighted average share price of 730 pence as of 23 June 2026 (being the day prior to the commencement of the offer period); and a premium of 46.6 per cent to the 3-month volume weighted average share price of 704 pence as of 23 June 2026 (being the day prior to the commencement of the offer period). The Best and Final Proposal values the issued and to be issued share capital of SEGRO at approximately £14.0 billion. *The Best and Final Proposal is final and will not be increased, except that Prologis reserves the right to increase and/or otherwise improve the Best and Final Proposal if: (i) there is an announcement on or after the date of this announcement of an offer or possible offer (including a partial offer involving the acquisition or consolidation of control (as defined in the Code)) for SEGRO by a third party offeror(s) or potential offeror(s) (whether identified or not), or (ii) the Takeover Panel otherwise provides its consent (which will only be provided in wholly exceptional circumstances). Following completion of the Combination and assuming that the Partial Cash Alternative is fully taken up, existing SEGRO shareholders would hold approximately 8.9 per cent of Prologis' issued share capital. Prologis also confirms that, in connection with the Combination, it intends to explore the feasibility of a secondary listing of Prologis shares on the London Stock Exchange if there is sufficient investor demand. For any such secondary listing to be feasible, Prologis expects that SEGRO Board engagement with Prologis will be required. Dan Letter, Chief Executive Officer of Prologis, Inc., commented: "There is no doubt a combination of both companies would deliver meaningful value. We have listened to feedback from shareholders and this morning, we have improved our proposal to make a compelling offer to the SEGRO Board. We run Prologis with discipline and this is our best and final offer." Prologis urges SEGRO shareholders to encourage the Board of SEGRO to extend the PUSU Deadline and recommend the Combination Prologis requests that SEGRO seeks from the Takeover Panel an extension to the PUSU Deadline of 5pm BST on 22 July 2026, in order to allow sufficient time to agree the other terms and conditions of a recommended firm offer to be made on the financial terms of the Best and Final Proposal. If after the date of this announcement SEGRO declares, makes or pays any dividend or distribution or other return of capital to its shareholders other than the Permitted Dividends, Prologis will make an equivalent reduction to the terms of the Best and Final Proposal. title: Watch as This NHRA Supercharger Gets Rebuilt Between Rounds
summary: Just about anyone who has taken on DIY projects has some familiarity with working on a deadline. Whether it’s your spouse needing to be able to drive to work on Monday or salvaging the tiny amount of joy left in a road trip by quickly patching something up to get moving again, the concept of […]
body_text: Just about anyone who has taken on DIY projects has some familiarity with working on a deadline. Whether it’s your spouse needing to be able to drive to work on Monday or salvaging the tiny amount of joy left in a road trip by quickly patching something up to get moving again, the concept of not only needing a job done but done right now is familiar to us all. Yet even in our most hurried moments, we are positively glacial compared to an NHRA Top Fuel competitor’s pit crew. Need proof? Watch in real time as John Force Racing’s Hunter Hagen services a supercharger between rounds. Top Fuel engines are carefully contained sticks of dynamite, and even when a quarter-mile pass goes as intended , there is still a lot of work to be done between rounds. Every component of the engine comes off or out and is inspected before rebuilding, replacement, or reuse. The massive supercharger force-feeding air into the eight cylinders is no different and gets a full refresh after each run. Hagen is the man who single-handedly takes care of this job, and does it quickly. The process starts by pulling the blower and mounting it to a custom fixture at the end of a table, a safe distance from the even more hectic work being done on the engine as it is still mounted in the chassis. The front and rear covers are pulled, then the pair of rotors is yanked out and taken into one of the team’s large trailers. Inside is a bench specially set up for removing and installing the seals on the rotors, and Hagen makes quick work of stripping, replacing, and finally precisely trimming the fresh seals. After a quick wipe down and lubrication, it’s back out to the table outside to start putting everything back together. John Force Racing The gears that time the rotors together. John Force Racing The new seals are pulled into channels and secured with small bolts. John Force Racing The front plate is press-fit into place using a small amount of heat. John Force Racing A dead blow hammer gets the front cover seated properly. John Force Racing It makes us cringe to see, but if it works, it works. John Force Racing Spinning over the supercharger by hand with a long ratchet. John Force Racing Watching the process along the way, I was surprised by the, well, aggression with which the parts could be handled. Just minutes after using a dial indicator to set fraction-of-an-inch specifications to the rotor seals, those same rotors were being “pressed” into the case with big blows from a soft-faced hammer. Racing is always a balance of skill and bravery. I’m not sure I’m brave enough to whack anything on a car that goes over 300 mph with a hammer, but there is a reason Hagen has that job and not me. This process seems simple at first glance, but that is more than likely the experience and confidence of a well-prepared crew shining through. This video appears to be filmed at a more relaxed race weekend, not between knock-out or final rounds at an NHRA championship event, but even while he’s being peppered with questions and distractions while working, Hagen has the supercharger ready to drop onto the engine long before the 45-minute mark. Impressive rebuild and impressive time. Of course, 3.91 seconds after the green light, it’s time to do it all again. Rising repair costs, pricier vehicles and more severe accidents have all pushed premiums higher. Many drivers have not seen their paychecks keep pace, so those increases land hard on household budgets. To download a high-resolution image, please click here: FOR MEDIA USE ONLY Key Highlights Proven performance: The certification validates Dyneema® DM20 fiber for permanent mooring lines, offering developers a proven, fatigue-resistant alternative to traditional steel chains in demanding marine environments. Global track record: Over 100 MW of floating offshore wind capacity in Europe currently relies on Dyneema® DM20 fiber. Expanding adoption: The ClassNK certification supports broader adoption of synthetic mooring lines made with Dyneema® DM20 fiber in Japan’s rapidly growing offshore wind market. CLEVELAND – July 8, 2026 – Avient Corporation, an innovator of materials solutions, today announced that its Dyneema® DM20 fiber has received Type Approval from Nippon Kaiji Kyokai (ClassNK) for use as filament in synthetic fiber ropes for floating offshore wind turbine (FOWT) mooring applications. As the offshore wind market expands globally, developers require reliable, long-term mooring materials. This certification validates Dyneema® DM20 fiber for permanent subsea installations, serving engineers, developers, and mooring line manufacturers. As floating offshore wind projects scale, mooring system performance plays a critical role in overall system reliability and long-term operation in demanding conditions. The ClassNK certification, issued in February 2026 and valid through February 2031, confirms that Dyneema® DM20 fiber complies with ClassNK guidelines for floating offshore wind turbines, including NKRE-GL-FOWT01 and related standards for marine materials and equipment. Dyneema® DM20 Fiber For FOWT Mooring Dyneema® DM20 fiber is a high-modulus polyethylene (HMPE) fiber that is molecularly engineered at the polymer level to resist fatigue under sustained, permanent loads. As a result, it is an excellent option for permanent mooring lines and subsea tether installations requiring high resistance to creep and long-term fatigue. Proven Track Record The ClassNK Type Approval builds on a strong operational track record across Europe, where Dyneema® DM20 fiber has already been deployed in several landmark FOWT demonstration projects. These projects include WindFloat Atlantic (2019), WindFloat Kincardine (2020/21), TetraSpar (2021), and the EFGL project in the Golfe du Lion. In total, more than 100 MW of floating offshore wind demonstration capacity in Europe has been installed with Dyneema® DM20 fiber-based mooring systems, providing valuable operational experience as the industry moves from demonstration to larger-scale deployment. title: The 7 best AI visibility tools to win AI search in 2026
summary: Explore these tried and tested AI visibility tools that help you monitor, analyze, and improve your brand presence across AI search engines.
body_text: AI visibility tools track how your brand appears in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, and similar platforms. They show where you're mentioned, where competitors outrank you, and which content gaps to close. Choosing the right one helps you avoid common pitfalls, like data overload, misleading signals, or investing in tools that don’t match your team’s goals, scale, or ability to act. This guide covers seven AI search monitoring tools tested against real AI search workflows. Rather than being another generic AI visibility tools comparison, we evaluated each platform based on where it excels, where it falls short, and which teams it's best suited for. The top AI visibility tools: in a nutshell Tool Best for Team size Choose if… Skip if… Semrush AI visibility + SEO at any scale Small teams to enterprise You want AI visibility tracking paired with SEO data and content workflows in one platform You only need a standalone AI visibility tracker and don't need SEO or content marketing capabilities. Peec AI Mid-market AI visibility tracking Growing teams, agencies You want flexible project-level tracking, competitor benchmarking, and AI visibility alerts You're looking for a low-cost entry point or need broad AI model coverage on a lower-tier plan. Profound Enterprise AEO intelligence and AI workflows Growth to enterprise teams You want AI agents that help uncover prompt opportunities, monitor how AI platforms represent your brand, and scale AEO workflows across content, SEO, and PR teams You want a lightweight platform with guided recommendations instead of analyst-focused data and workflows. Writesonic AI visibility + content execution Small to mid-sized content teams You want to spot AI search gaps and act on them through content, audits, and optimization workflows Your team already has well-established content creation workflows and needs AI visibility tracking only. Otterly AI Affordable AI monitoring Freelancers, small teams You want a low-cost way to monitor AI mentions, citations, and basic GEO signals You need enterprise-grade AI visibility tracking, advanced analytics, or all major AI models included by default. Botify Technical SEO for large sites Enterprise SEO teams You manage large, complex sites where crawlability and bot behavior matter Your focus is content strategy rather than technical SEO Athena Growth teams linking visibility to traffic Mid-market teams, agencies You want to connect AI visibility data to traffic, content performance, and citation opportunities You need predictable fixed pricing, a lightweight monitoring tool, or a mature self-serve free trial. Let’s look at each of them in detail. 1. Semrush: Best for AI visibility + SEO tracking at any scale Semrush brings AI visibility tracking, SEO, competitor research, and content optimization into one platform — so the tools you need to understand and improve your brand presence live in one place. That matters because AI visibility doesn't exist in isolation. The same topical authority, backlink profile, and entity signals that influence your Google rankings can also improve your visibility in AI platforms. We use Semrush internally to monitor our own AI visibility, and acting on the data it surfaced helped us grow our AI share of voice from 13% to 32% in one month. For SMBs and agencies, the Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit helps you measure your presence in AI answers and track mentions and citations over time. Analyze competitors and identify topic, prompt, and source gaps where rivals are mentioned over you to prioritize which gaps to close first. The toolkit also includes Brand Performance reports that help you understand how AI platforms describe your brand . Analyze your AI share of voice , sentiment, narrative drivers, and the specific questions users ask AI systems about your company. This helps you understand not just whether your brand appears in AI-generated answers, but how it's positioned relative to competitors. For larger teams managing multiple brands, markets, or product lines across global regions, Semrush offers Enterprise AIO . It has the same core AI visibility capabilities, but at a larger scale and with more granular tracking. Track visibility by product, persona, region, and category, analyze the source-level signals shaping AI answers, and get recommendations on what to fix next. That breadth is one of Semrush's biggest strengths, but it also means the platform can feel like more than you need if you're simply looking for a lightweight AI mention tracker. It delivers the most value when AI visibility is part of a broader SEO and content workflow. Top features One of the largest prompt databases: Access 289M+ LLM prompts globally to inform your AI search strategy Wide platform coverage: Track across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and AI Overviews, with Claude, DeepSeek, Grok, and others added in the Enterprise AIO plan Brand performance and AI sentiment: Understand public sentiment about your brand versus competitors and get recommendations to improve your AI share of voice Prompt research and tracking: Find AI search topics with high volume, analyze difficulty, and understand intent — then monitor visibility for the prompts that matter most and act quickly on sudden drops Competitor benchmarking: Compare visibility, positioning, mentions, and citations against rivals in real time on Enterprise AIO AI shopping visibility: Track how your products appear in ChatGPT Shopping and Google AI Mode (Enterprise AIO) What makes it special The entire workflow is covered — from finding target AI prompts and tracking visibility to analyzing competitors, monitoring brand perception, and following targeted rankings. With Semrush One , you get the complete picture of your organic presence across Google and AI search platforms with data on AI prompts, mentions, keywords, backlinks, citations, and more. The tool generates actionable business, product, and marketing recommendations based on LLM data to help you improve your AI visibility. For enterprise teams, source-level intelligence shows which publications, narratives, and signals shape AI answers in your category, so you know what's driving visibility, not just the raw metrics. Semrush’s AI prompt database includes 289M+ prompts , and it sits alongside its traditional SEO database of 28B+ keywords and 43T backlinks. So you can seamlessly connect AI visibility with the authority, search demand, and competitive signals that influence it. Pricing Semrush AI Visibility pricing starts at $99/month per domain. Another option is Semrush One , which combines the SEO and AI Visibility Toolkits into a single subscription. Semrush One starts at $199/month. To get a quote for Semrush Enterprise, reach out to the team to discuss a custom plan. 2. Peec AI: Best for mid-market AI visibility tracking Peec AI gives marketing teams a straightforward way to track AI visibility without the complexity of enterprise platforms. With custom alerts, it flags your visibility gains or losses for specific prompts, which is useful for teams running active campaigns or product launches that need to catch any drops as quickly as possible. The platform has evolved significantly and now sits closer to mid-market AI visibility platforms than entry-level tools. This AI visibility tool is best suited for growing marketing teams and agencies that need flexible tracking, competitor benchmarking, and project-level visibility management. Here, the only trade-off is that lower-tier plans include only three AI models. So, if you need broader LLM coverage, you'll need to add models or move to Enterprise. Top features Wide platform coverage: Track visibility across three LLMs of your choice, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and Grok Prompt discovery: Find high-impact prompts using AI-suggested queries and search volume data Source analysis: See which sites AI tools cite most often to inform your content and outreach strategy Sentiment tracking: Monitor how AI platforms perceive and frame your brand Competitor benchmarking: Compare your visibility, position, and sentiment against key rivals Flexible project management: Allocate prompts, AI engines, and tracking frequency independently for each project What makes it special Alerts help you identify sudden gains or losses for specific prompts Export and integrate data via CSV, Looker Studio connector, or API to build custom reports and automate workflows Project-level flexibility allows teams to customize tracking by project, engine, and monitoring frequency It supports AI search monitoring across 80+ countries, which helps brands compare localized AI visibility instead of treating every answer engine result as one global experience. Actionable recommendations help turn visibility data into clear next steps Pricing For brands Starter ($95/month): Includes 50 prompts; three AI models; unlimited users; daily tracking; one project. Pro ($245/month): Includes 150 prompts; three AI models; unlimited users; daily tracking; two projects. Advanced ($495/month): Includes 350 prompts; three AI models; five projects; multi-country tracking; Looker Studio integration. Enterprise (custom pricing): Includes unlimited projects; access to all AI models; customizable prompt tracking; API access; SSO. For agencies Essential ($245/month): Includes 10,000 credits; around 111 prompts; three projects; three client seats; up to 25 active pitch projects. Growth ($495/month): Includes 25,000 credits; around 277 prompts; 10 projects; five client seats; up to 50 active pitch projects. Scale ($795/month): Includes 65,000 credits; around 722 prompts; 25 projects; seven client seats; up to 75 active pitch projects. Comprehensive (custom pricing): Includes unlimited credits; all AI models; API access; MCP integration; SSO; custom integrations. 3. Profound: Best for advanced AI analytics Profound is designed for analyst-driven teams that need high-frequency monitoring and prefer building their own reports. Because insights are delivered primarily through raw data, dashboards, and exports, teams typically need analysts or business intelligence (BI) support to turn findings into action. The platform tracks AI visibility changes in near real time, so technical teams can catch AI visibility drops as they happen. CSV exports and API-first integrations are especially important for workflows where analysts build their own reports and model the data themselves. Enterprise ecommerce teams can also use the ChatGPT Shopping Visibility feature to see how products appear in AI-powered shopping experiences. Side-note: Many of Profound's most advanced capabilities, including broader model coverage, Prompt Volumes, APIs, and MCP support, are reserved for higher-tier plans. The Starter plan offers a much narrower experience than the platform's Enterprise positioning might suggest. Top features High-frequency tracking: Daily monitoring to catch AI visibility changes quickly Technical integrations: Connects with Akamai, AWS, Cloudflare, GA4, Vercel, Netlify, and others Shopping visibility: Track how products surface in ChatGPT's shopping ecosystem (Enterprise plan) Intent and sentiment analysis: Understand how AI platforms frame and perceive your brand Agent Analytics: See how AI crawlers access and interpret your site, track which pages get referenced in AI answers, and submit new content directly to AI crawlers What makes it special Works well for large teams that prefer raw data exports and custom dashboards — CSV workflows and API access let analysts model the data themselves Near real-time change detection helps teams identify AI visibility shifts as they happen Built for broader enterprise coverage, with support for 30+ languages and 150+ regions, while Enterprise plans can track up to 10 answer engines. Also, it’s prompt research reports use a proprietary dataset of 1.5B+ real user prompts. Agent Analytics gives technical teams visibility into AI bot behavior at the server level ChatGPT Shopping visibility helps ecommerce brands understand how products appear in AI-driven buying experiences Pricing For brands: Starter ($99/month): Includes ChatGPT tracking; 50 tracked prompts; 1,500 responses/month; 100 Agent credits for content generation and optimization; email support. Growth ($399/month): Includes ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews; 100 tracked prompts; 9,000 responses/month; 400 Agent credits for content generation and optimization; CSV/JSON exports; three seats; email support. Enterprise (custom pricing): Includes up to 10 answer engines; ChatGPT Shopping; Prompt Volumes; API access; SSO/SAML; SOC2 compliance; dedicated Slack support. For agencies: Agency Growth ($99/month + add-ons): Includes 10 pitch workspaces/month; Agency Mode; consolidated billing; client workspaces available as add-ons; email support. Agency Enterprise (custom pricing): Includes tailored client and trial workspaces; API access; SSO; premium Slack support; dedicated agency partner. 4. Writesonic: Best for built-in content optimization workflows Writesonic combines AI visibility tracking with content creation in a single platform. It works well for small content teams that want to see where they're mentioned, spot AI visibility gaps , and act on them without switching tools. On the visibility side, you can track your brand across ChatGPT, Gemini, and AI Overviews, monitor sentiment, and see which prompts drive mentions. On the content side, the platform generates long-form articles with automatic fact-checking, internal linking, and SEO optimization, so you can go from spotting a gap to publishing a finished piece in one workflow. But also, it means if your team already has established editorial workflows and dedicated writing tools, some of Writesonic's biggest differentiators may overlap with your existing stack. Top features AI visibility tracking: Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, and citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews, Perplexity, Copilot, and other LLMs, depending on your plan AI search volume data: See how often users use specific prompts across AI platforms Content engine: Create fact-checked, internally linked articles optimized for SEO and AI search Content refresh alerts: Spot pages losing AI visibility and get update recommendations Prompt tracking: Monitor AI prompts and visibility trends Action Center: Get on-page and off-page recommendations designed to improve AI visibility Writesonic is best suited for teams that value speed and execution over in-depth AI analytics. What makes it special Combines AI visibility tracking with content creation, helping teams move from insight to execution quickly Action Center provides AI search optimization recommendations based on AI visibility data Fits teams that prioritize execution speed over deep analytics AI visibility and content workflows live in the same platform Its AI search dataset covers 2B+ real AI conversations across 10 platforms and 50+ markets Pricing For brands: Starter ($99/month): Includes 50 prompts; ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews tracking; 15 AI articles/month; 10 site audits; email support. Basic ($249/month): Includes 100 prompts; 25 AI articles/month; 20 site audits; larger page limits; email support. Growth ($499/month): Includes 200 prompts; sentiment analysis; limited Action Center; 50 AI articles/month; 50 site audits; priority email support. Enterprise (custom pricing): Includes all 10 AI platforms; full Action Center; Brand Explorer; Looker Studio; AI search strategist; SSO/SAML; dedicated support. For agencies: Agency Starter ($250/month): Includes up to 20 pitch projects/month; 2,000 answers/month; shareable audit reports; unlimited users. Agency Enterprise (custom pricing): Includes custom client workspaces; white-label reporting; all 10 AI platforms; Action Center; dedicated AI search strategist. 5. Otterly AI: Best for foundational and cost-effective AI monitoring Otterly AI is a straightforward AI visibility tool for small teams, freelancers, or agencies that need affordable monitoring without complex setup. The tool converts keywords into AI-friendly prompts — enter a broad term like "SEO tools" and it generates relevant prompts to track. You can also run GEO URL audits to check whether pages are ready for AI search. It’s useful for identifying basic AI-readiness issues, rather than deep technical or enterprise-level audits. Just keep in mind that Claude, Google AI Mode, and Gemini aren't included by default and require paid add-ons. Top features AI platform coverage: Track brand mentions and share of voice across ChatGPT, AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Copilot. Add Claude, Google AI Mode, and Gemini for additional fees . AI keyword research: Generate relevant prompts from keywords, brand name, or website URL Citation analysis: See the most cited URLs in AI responses and analyze them to inform your content strategy GEO audits: Assess your site's AI readiness with audits covering 25+ on-page factors Unlimited workspaces: Agencies can separate client data across workspaces (Standard and Premium plans) What makes it special Lower entry price at $29/month makes it accessible for freelancers and small teams testing AI visibility tracking GEO audits identify specific on-page issues limiting your AI citations, with clear tasks to fix them Unlimited team members on all plans, so you're not paying per seat Pricing Lite ($29/month): Includes 15 search prompts; tracking across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot; unlimited team members; daily tracking. Standard ($189/month): Includes 100 search prompts; unlimited workspaces; API access; MCP integration; Looker Studio connector. Premium ($489/month): Includes 400 search prompts; API access; MCP integration; personal onboarding; option to purchase additional prompts. Enterprise (custom pricing): Includes custom search prompts; SSO; personalized onboarding; quarterly GEO health checks. Claude, Google AI Mode, and Gemini are available as paid add-ons across all plans. Also, Otterly AI offers a free trial so you can test it out before committing. 6. Botify: Best for technical SEO experts managing large sites Botify is built for enterprise SEO teams managing large websites (thousands or millions of pages) where technical issues directly impact visibility. The platform combines crawl data, log files, and Google Search Console data to show how search engines and AI bots actually interact with your site. Deploy sitewide fixes (nofollow tags, redirect chains, meta updates) without waiting on developers, and push pages directly to AI search engines for faster indexing. Botify is purpose-built for enterprise technical SEO. If your primary goal is monitoring brand visibility in AI search rather than managing large-scale site infrastructure, much of the platform's functionality may be unnecessary. Top features First-party data foundation : Uses your site crawls, log files, and GSC data to show how bots access and interpret your pages Unified search analytics : Track visibility across traditional search and AI platforms in one view Automated deployment : Create, test, and deploy technical fixes at scale without developer support ActionBoard : Surfaces technical risks and opportunities with prioritized recommendations AI search submission : Push pages directly to AI search engines to surface content faster What makes it special Botify’s SiteCrawler can crawl up to 50 million URLs per crawl at 250 URLs per second, and render JavaScript at 100 URLs per second. Combines crawl, log file, and GSC data into one view — so you see how bots actually access your site, not just what shows up in search results Deploys technical fixes at scale without developer involvement, cutting optimization timelines from months to minutes Best suited for enterprise teams where site complexity is the bottleneck — if you're managing millions of pages, this is built specifically for that level of scale and complexity Pricing Custom pricing. 7. Athena: Best for mid-market growth teams Athena is a generative engine optimization platform built for growth teams that need AI visibility tracking alongside content optimization tools. It was built by former Google Search and DeepMind engineers and has backing from Y Combinator The platform tracks visibility across key AI platforms and shows which prompts drive mentions, where competitors outrank you, and what content gaps to close. You can then create AI-optimized content drafts with brand voice enforcement and use citation intelligence to find outreach opportunities. Athena works well for B2B SaaS teams tracking how AI search drives demos, DTC brands focused on share of voice, and agencies managing multiple client accounts from one dashboard. Ecommerce teams can integrate it with Shopify or Webflow to publish GEO-ready content and attribute AI search impact directly. Just keep in mind that Athena uses a credit-based pricing model. So, teams with heavy monitoring needs should keep an eye on usage because costs scale with consumption. Starter ($295/month): Includes $300 in monthly credits; visibility across nine AI models; API access; content optimization agent; CSV exports. Enterprise (custom pricing): Includes Athena Citation Engine (ACE); multi-region and multi-language support; executive dashboards; SSO; white-glove onboarding. Athena does not offer a free trial. However, new users can access a discounted first month starting at $95 before moving to standard pricing. How to choose the best AI visibility tool Most teams don't need the most powerful AI search visibility tools. They need the one that fits their existing stack, matches their team size, and supports how they actually work. Before you make a decision, answer three questions: Does it fit your current stack? If you already use a platform like Semrush for SEO, adding a standalone AI visibility tool means a separate budget, onboarding, and reporting format. Tools that integrate with your existing workflow and offer SEO + AI search reporting reduce friction. How much data does your team actually need? Smaller teams can get useful signals from lightweight tools like the Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit or Otterly AI. Larger brands operating across multiple markets need granular tracking by region, product, and persona — tools like Semrush’s Enterprise AIO and Botify are built for that complexity. Do you need monitoring, execution, or both? Some tools only track visibility. Others let you act on AI visibility gaps directly — finding topic ideas, getting recommendations, creating content, identifying outreach targets, or deploying technical fixes. If you have writers and strategists ready to execute, monitoring is enough. If you need help going from insight to action, choose a tool with built-in content or optimization workflows. Some platforms offer free trials or free tiers, while others require a demo call or paid subscription before you can test the product. If hands-on evaluation is important to your team, trial availability should also be part of your decision-making process. Start tracking and growing your brand visibility Every AI visibility tool on this list solves a specific problem for teams with AI visibility challenges. Some are built for enterprise scale, others for small teams on a budget, and others for content execution. There's no single "best" AI visibility tool. The best AI search trackers are the ones that match your team's workflow, technical maturity, and budget. Pick the one that matches your team size, stack, and workflow — and get started now to control your brand’s narrative and stay competitive. Remember, AI search adds a new layer to how customers find you, but it doesn't replace traditional search. If you want AI visibility and SEO data connected in a single platform, Semrush One brings both together, with actionable recommendations to help you grow faster. FAQs What is the best AI visibility tool for small businesses? The best AI visibility tools for most small businesses are Semrush and Otterly AI. The Semrush AI Visibility toolkit combines AI visibility tracking with SEO, competitor research, and content optimization, while Otterly AI offers a lower-cost entry point for monitoring mentions, citations, and visibility trends. The best choice depends on whether you need a complete AI visibility platform or a lightweight monitoring tool. What platforms do AI visibility tools track? AI visibility tools track some combination of these platforms, depending on the tool: ChatGPT Google AI Overviews Google AI Mode Gemini Perplexity Claude Microsoft Copilot Grok DeepSeek Enterprise platforms typically offer the broadest coverage, while lower-tier plans may only include a subset of these platforms. Do AI visibility tools require a free trial before buying? No, AI visibility tools don't require a free trial before buying, but availability varies by platform. Some platforms offer free trials, free audits, or free tiers, while others require a paid subscription or demo before you can access the product. For example, Peec AI offers a free trial on select plans, while Athena and Profound currently do not offer free trials. How is AI visibility different from SEO? AI visibility is different from SEO in what it measures. SEO focuses on improving visibility in traditional search, while AI visibility focuses on how often your brand appears in AI-generated answers from platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode. The two are closely related because many of the signals that influence search rankings also affect AI visibility, but they measure different outcomes. What is the cheapest AI visibility tool? Based on publicly available pricing, Otterly AI currently offers one of the cheapest AI visibility tools, with plans starting at $29 per month. However, pricing changes frequently, so it's always worth checking the vendor's website before making a decision. What is the best AI search monitoring tool? The best AI search monitoring tool depends on your goals. If you want AI visibility tracking combined with SEO and content insights, Semrush is a strong choice. If you need analyst-focused reporting and raw data exports, Profound may be a better fit. If your priority is content creation and execution, Writesonic combines monitoring and content workflows in one platform.
